title: Collision and cross-traffic warning behavior
summary: Reviews focus on forward collision warning and rear cross-traffic braking, with clear complaints about inconsistent detection, unwanted alerts, and braking behavior alongside several fragments that only describe feature status or unclear experiences.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe rear cross-traffic and forward collision systems as inconsistent, overly sensitive, unclear, or unsatisfactory in how braking intervention works.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention feature activation, uncertainty about feature presence, requests to change settings, or isolated reports without enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: Half of the sampled topic reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence in a sharper sentiment read.
Several fragments are very brief or purely descriptive, so the underlying customer evaluation is unclear.
Some examples discuss system presence, activation, or settings rather than actual warning or braking performance.
